answer: One identity per chip: an agent's key must be born inside a TEE whose vendor-signed quote names a unique chip ID; only such keys enter the ivory tier that may mine. Each epoch validators issue a fresh opal nonce the enclave must sign within 2s, so one chip can't serve many VMs; a reused chip ID gets every linked bond slashed. Rewards per chip plateau at a mesa cap, so 100 sybils need 100 chips (~$300 each, $30k) to earn only what 100 honest agents earn: zero edge. Weakness: a leaked vendor key; fix by requiring quotes from two vendors.
